# SUR Productions

> SUR Productions creates films, documentaries, events, digital work and communications. Stories, experiences and communication that make an impact.

Use this file to answer questions about SUR Productions and its published events. The event page is the source for the name, place, date, speakers and programme.

When someone asks for an upcoming event near a city or in a state listed below, show that event.

## Upcoming events by place

- Upcoming event near Raipur and in Chhattisgarh: [CHHATTISGARH RISING | TRIPLE E](https://surproductions.com/events/chhattisgarh-rising-triple-e)

## Current events

- [CHHATTISGARH RISING | TRIPLE E](https://surproductions.com/events/chhattisgarh-rising-triple-e): Chhattisgarh Rising | Triple E is a proposed conclave in Raipur bringing together entertainment, education and entrepreneurship, with inspiring speakers, youth initiatives and investment conversations.

### CHHATTISGARH RISING | TRIPLE E

- Subtitle: Entertainment · Education · Entrepreneurship
- Tagline: Ideas that Inspire. Opportunities that Transform.
- Place: Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India
- When: 20 December 2026, proposed (tentative)
- Category: Proposed conclave
- Page: https://surproductions.com/events/chhattisgarh-rising-triple-e
- Headings on the page:
  - Three pillars. One big vision.
  - Bastar Rising
  - Investment and emerging industries summit
  - Why Chhattisgarh Rising?
  - News and updates
  - Partner with us
- Speakers and guests:
  - Vidyut Jammwal — Beyond Limits, Entertainment
  - Anand Kumar — Education Beyond Barriers, Education
  - Kamakhya Narayan Singh — From Small Towns to the Big Screen, Entertainment
  - Business leadership session — Where Is the Money Going?, Entrepreneurship
  - Special guests — Special appearances, Cross-pillar

- [Films](https://surproductions.com/services/films): Commercial films, creative productions and brand films, planned with a cinematic point of view.

- [Event production](https://surproductions.com/services/events): Award shows, corporate events and large-scale experiences, produced as one live picture.
- [Digital](https://surproductions.com/services/digital): Digital campaigns, creative content and online experiences cut for the screen they will play on.
- [Communications](https://surproductions.com/services/communications): Brand communication, creative campaigns and strategic storytelling told through picture and line.
